title: 국군화생방방호사령부령 / queue:ADDENDUM:28266:20170905:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Decree of the Military Personnel Management Act) <No. 28266, September 5, 2017>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted>

Articles 2 and 3 Omitted.

Article 4 (Amendment of Other Statutes or Regulations) (1) through (19) Omitted.

(20) Part of the Decree on the Armed Forces Chemical, Biological and Radiological Defense Command shall be amended as follows:

In Article 3 (2), "field-grade officer" shall be replaced with "general officer".

(21) through (90) Omitted.
